parameters.description: The date for which the information should be returned. Normally, this is the current conditions (which is the default value) but under some circumstances, systems need to acccess this information as it would have been in the past. A typical example of this would be where code selection is constrained to the set of codes that were available when the patient was treated, not when the record is being edited. Note that which date is appropriate is a matter for implementation policy.

parameters.description: A property that the client wishes to be returned in the output. If no properties are specified, the server chooses what to return. The following properties are defined for all code systems: name, version (code system info) and code information: display, designation, and lang.X where X is a designation language code. These properties are returned explicitly in named out parameters with matching names, or in designations. In addition, any property codes defined by [this specification](codesystem.html#defined-props) or by the CodeSystem ([CodeSystem.property.code](codesystem-definitions.html#CodeSystem.property)) are allowed, and these are returned in the out parameter ```property```

result.description: The base-unit canonical form of the provided UCUM expression

CanonicaliseResponse.description: Response containing a UCUM code converted into its base-unit canonical form

path.description: Request path that resulted in the error

message.example: Defined unit with code 'll' was not found

Error.description: Standard error response containing an HTTP status, a path and an error message

dimension.description: Dimension symbol representing the base physical dimension of the unit (e.g., 'L' for length, 'M' for mass)

result.description: Converted numeric value resulting from the conversion

ConvertResponse.description: Response containing the converted value for the provided input in the target unit

result.description: Human-readable form of the UCUM expression

AnalyseResponse.description: Response containing a UCUM code converted into a human-readable expression

UcumExportUnit.description: A UCUM unit with merged base and supplement designations

supplement.description: Indicates whether the designation originated from a supplement

preferred.description: Indicates whether the designation is preferred

UcumExportDesignation.description: A UCUM designation in the export output

supplements.description: Optional list of UCUM supplement ids or canonical URLs. When omitted, all UCUM supplements are used.

UcumExportRequest.description: Request for exporting UCUM units with supplements

special.description: Flags whether this unit is a special UCUM unit requiring custom conversion functions (non-ratio scale)

valid.description: Indicates whether the UCUM code passed validation

errorMessage.description: Error message if the UCUM code is invalid

ValidateResponse.description: Response indicating whether the UCUM code is valid and an optional error message

version.description: The version of the UCUM specification

releaseDate.description: The release date of the UCUM specification
